blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A fire that struck a mall warehouse in Barangay Banilad, Cebu City, on Sunday morning caused an estimated P1.6 million in damage, according to the Cebu City Fire Station (CCFS). The fire at Gaisano Country Mall’s storage warehouse was declared out at 11:31 a.m. or 30 minutes after it was placed under control at 11:01 a.m. CCFS said that the warehouse, owned by Gaisano Brothers Merchandising Inc., sustained partial damage.
